properties.name: Delta Rides
properties.units: DeSoto County; Tunica County; Tate County; Panola County; Coahoma County; Quitman County; Tallahatchie County; Yalobusha County; Grenada County; Bolivar County; Sunflower County; Leflore County; Carroll County; Montgomery County; Washington County; Humphreys County; Holmes County; Sharkey County; Yazoo County; Issaquena County
properties.note: County list read directly off MDOT's official 'Regional Coordination Transportation Groups' map (mdot.ms.gov/connectms/images/regional-map.pdf), which color-codes every MS county by its ConnectMS regional network; these 20 counties are shaded as the Delta Rides (orange) region. MDOT's ConnectMS page and Delta Rides' own site (yourdeltarides.org) both state the region as '21' or '20+' counties without naming them, so this list may be missing one county at the boundary with the Trans-Con/EZTAG regions (Attala County was ambiguous on the map and is not included here).

properties.name: SMART
properties.units: Claiborne County; Jefferson County; Adams County; Franklin County; Amite County; Wilkinson County; Pike County; Walthall County; Lincoln County; Lawrence County; Jefferson Davis County; Copiah County
properties.note: County list read directly off MDOT's official 'Regional Coordination Transportation Groups' map (mdot.ms.gov/connectms/images/regional-map.pdf), which color-codes every MS county by its ConnectMS regional network; these 12 counties are shaded as the SMART (yellow) region in southwest MS. MDOT's ConnectMS page and the Mississippi Public Transit Association both cite '13 counties,' so one boundary county may be missing (the yellow/Trans-Con line near Copiah/Simpson was hard to place precisely); no independent SMART operator website was found to confirm the exact list.
